findings.summary: The container-sharing guidance is split into bullets plus a table, and the key rule is mixed into one bullet.
findings.evidence: Containers in a task share one network namespace and lifecycle
findings.fix: Split into two bullets: 'share one network namespace' and 'share one lifecycle (start and stop together)'.

findings.summary: The ':latest' mistake is told as a chain of text lines instead of a small flow, and one bullet holds several ideas.
findings.evidence: Old revision pulls the new broken image: no rollback
findings.fix: Show the chain as a short diagram (revision 6 and revision 7 both point to :latest, which now points to the broken image) and split the consequence from the 'no rollback' conclusion.

findings.summary: The ECS hierarchy is stated as a list of boxes without showing the nesting or the relationship direction.
findings.evidence: Cluster holds services / Service keeps N tasks / Task running instance / Task definition the blueprint
findings.fix: Draw it as a nested or arrow diagram: Cluster > Service > Task, with Task definition feeding Task.

findings.summary: The 'Mistake' section is a single dense sentence holding two causes and two symptoms.
findings.evidence: Task stuck in PROVISIONING or STOPPED: no route to ECR (private subnet without NAT or VPC endpoints) or the execution role lacks permission.
findings.fix: Use a two-row cause/fix table or two bullets: 'No route to ECR: add NAT or VPC endpoints' and 'Execution role lacks pull permission: grant it'.

findings.summary: Bullets hold more than one idea, and the rollout/rollback settings are not explained.
findings.fix: Give each setting its own bullet with its meaning (floor of healthy tasks, ceiling of total tasks during a deploy).

findings.summary: The comparison table says Fargate scales to "Any size", which is false and teaches the wrong limit.
findings.evidence: Scale | Any size, no hosts | Very large steady workloads
findings.fix: Change the Fargate cell to "No hosts to scale, but task size is capped (16 vCPU)". Keep EC2 as the pick for very large steady workloads.

findings.summary: The Fargate vs EC2 table cells are mixed: the 'Cost' and 'Scale' rows do not compare like with like, and the Fargate/EC2 explanation is split between bullets and the table.
findings.evidence: Scale | Any size, no hosts | Very large steady workloads
findings.fix: Make the rows parallel (e.g. Scale: 'No hosts to size' vs 'You size and manage the fleet') and move the bullets about patching and capacity providers into table rows.

findings.summary: A bullet holds multiple ideas and the key comparison fact is buried in a prose sentence.
findings.evidence: You pay later in upgrade work (a Kubernetes version gets ~14 months of support), add-ons and networking complexity.
findings.fix: Split into bullets: upgrade work (~14 months support per version), add-on management, networking complexity.

findings.summary: The docker login command is incomplete: it omits the username and `--password-stdin`, so it would not authenticate.
findings.fix: Use: aws ecr get-login-password --region $REGION | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin $ECR

findings.summary: The ECR login command is incomplete and would fail as written.
findings.fix: Use `aws ecr get-login-password --region $REGION | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin $ECR`.

findings.summary: Commands are shown as a block with several update-service forms and the idea behind them comes after the code.
findings.evidence:
aws ecs update-service --task-definition fam:rev --force-new-deployment
...
update-service points the service at a revision
Redeploy is not rollout
findings.fix: State the one-line idea before the code block, and show register then update-service as separate commands with --force-new-deployment explained in a separate line.

findings.summary: The ALB and security group relationship is a list of labels rather than a followable diagram.
findings.evidence: Internet 80 / 443 ALB group open to internet Task group container port, source = ALB group
findings.fix: Draw arrows: Internet -> (80/443) ALB SG -> (container port) Task SG, labelling the task SG source as the ALB SG.

findings.summary: The cheat sheet shows code before the idea behind it, and repeats the --force-new-deployment mistake text from pages 2 and 5.
findings.evidence:
bash
docker push $ACCT.dkr.ecr.$REGION.amazonaws.com/app:$SHA
...
update-service points the service at the revision
findings.fix: Put the one-line idea ('Push, register, then point the service at the new revision') above the code block.

findings.summary: The debug checklist's 'Check' cells pack several checks into single cells.
findings.evidence: CannotPullContainerError (NAT or endpoints); execution role; missing log group
findings.fix: Split into one row per check, each with its symptom and fix.
